Soft spice oat biscuits

Fűszeres puha keksz

10 months+ Replaced 30 min 10 portions

From 10 months, and only while they stay soft. If a biscuit dries hard, do not serve it. Everyday wheat still belongs in pasta or bread through the week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 100 g rolled oats (finely ground if you want a smoother biscuit)
  • 80 g unsweetened apple purée (the only sweetener)
  • 1/4 tsp ground cinnamon (a mild spice, not a sweet coating)
  • from a quarter orange orange zest (washed orange; zest only, no pith)
  • 1 tbsp rapeseed or olive oil (helps the biscuit stay soft)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 160 C.
  2. Mix the oats, apple purée, cinnamon, and orange zest.
  3. Stir in the oil to make a soft dough.
  4. Drop small thick mounds on a tray and flatten them slightly.
  5. Bake only until set, not until brown and crisp.
  6. Cool in a covered tin and check that each biscuit bends rather than snaps.

Replaced

The usual honey-spice biscuit at 10 months is the wrong sweetener and often too hard. Honey is unsafe before 12 months even when baked, and it is still sugar after that.

Bake soft cinnamon and orange-zest oat biscuits sweetened with apple purée. Use no honey, and keep the biscuits soft.
